content.short: Suby accepts card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna and stablecoin payments with bank or wallet withdrawal.
content.description: Suby is an API-first, non-custodial checkout accepting cards, wallets, Klarna and stablecoins, with settlement to either a bank account or a stablecoin wallet. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Offering Klarna alongside stablecoins is a fair illustration of where this category has landed: crypto as one option in a conventional checkout rather than a separate flow.
